summary: The official program and linked application advertise up to $200,000 combined Databricks and Neon credits; the application splits this into $100K for Databricks and $100K for Neon and lets applicants select either or both. Awards require approval. The linked application requires accounts for the selected products with payment methods on file; Databricks applicants supply an account email and Account ID, and Neon applicants supply an account email and Org ID and confirm a paid plan. LinkedIn identity verification is required before submitting. Funding eligibility needs confirmation: the announcement targets venture-backed pre-seed through Series A companies, while the application welcomes bootstrapped teams and offers that funding-status option but also displays “At least $1M raised, or backing from a recognized accelerator or fund.” Raised-funding applicants must supply investors and verification; the shipped form hides those questions for bootstrapped/prefer-not-to-say selections. Do not infer guaranteed eligibility from that branch. Ask startup-program@databricks.com which criteria apply. No enrollment deadline, credit-use validity or paid-customer exclusion was established, and no account, payment or application was submitted.
claim_steps: Open the official program page and its linked application. Choose Databricks, Neon, or both; the displayed maximum is $100K per product, $200K combined, subject to approval.

Confirm funding eligibility with startup-program@databricks.com: the form welcomes bootstrapped teams but also displays at least $1M raised or recognized accelerator/fund backing; the announcement targets venture-backed startups.

Prepare accounts for each selected product with payment methods on file. Databricks requires its account email and Account ID; Neon requires its account email and Org ID plus confirmation of a paid plan.

Provide company contact, website, incorporation country, funding status and project details. If selecting raised funding, supply investors and the requested backing-verification link, code or VC contact.
Complete the required LinkedIn identity verification and application consent, then submit only if you accept the account/payment requirements. Approval and actual award are not guaranteed.
Before using credits, confirm their validity, covered services and post-grant billing in writing; the application does not establish that usage beyond the award will stay free.
